instruction: You are facing a kitchen.Turn to our right so that we are seeing the middle counter on our left and the double stove on our right. Walk straight out of the kitchen and take the first right. You will see a brown leather sectional couch. When you reach the back of the couch. Take a right. Now you will walk from the wood to the tile ahead of you into the very first opening on the right. It will be after the black candle holder. Once you are in that opening, take your first left into the bathroom. Walk to the back wall in front of the toilet. You will see a wall that looks like cards and some flowers. You are at your destination.
